newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch AEX share index breaks 700 barrier.
newsitem.headline: Dutch AEX share index breaks 700 barrier.

text.p: The AEX index of 25 leading Dutch shares crossed the 700 level for the first time on Tuesday, up 5.27 points to a record intra-day high of 700.31.
The previous all-time high of 698.21 was set on Tuesday as was the closing high of 695.04.

Dealers said fourth quarter results from Unilever came at the upper end of expectations sending the shares sprinting ahead and boosting the index as did a double figure advance on Wall Street on Tuesday after Monday's 50-point fall.

A firmer dollar and bond prices also played their part in supporting the market, although dealers pointed out that Unilever's 18.70 guilder gain to 332.10 guilders accounted for roughly 4.00 points of Tuesday's AEX index gain.
Chart analysts on Monday identified 700 on the AEX as first resistance, followed by second resistance at 715-720.
